view: PA (frontal), upright; L side marker present at image upper right, confirming conventional orientation
technical_quality: Adequate penetration, minimal rotation, slightly reduced inspiration (about 9 posterior ribs on the right, with an elevated right hemidiaphragm); costophrenic angles and apices included

devices.type: Radiographic side marker 'L' with technologist initials (external artifact)
devices.location: Image upper right corner, over patient's left shoulder soft tissue

abnormalities.finding: Small-to-moderate pleural effusion: blunted costophrenic angle with a lateral meniscus rising along the chest wall, hazy adjacent lung base
Elevated right hemidiaphragm (about 5-6 cm higher than left) with a relatively preserved costophrenic angle; subpulmonic effusion versus eventration not excluded
Dense irregular calcified opacity at the anterior first costochondral junction, most consistent with costal cartilage calcification (benign); not a parenchymal nodule with certainty
Mildly increased bronchovascular/interstitial markings at the lung bases

description_zh: 正面（PA）胸部X光片，右上角可見 L 側標記。左側肋膈角變鈍，並可見沿左側胸壁上升之半月形液面（meniscus），左下肺野基底呈霧狀增加密度，符合左側少至中量肋膜積液（垂直高度約5公分）；右側肋膈角大致銳利，但右側橫膈明顯抬高，不排除右側肺下型積液或橫膈膨升。心影擴大（心胸比約0.57），主動脈弓突出迂曲；右上肺野外側第一肋軟骨處可見緻密不規則鈣化，最可能為肋軟骨鈣化。未見任何導管、引流管、心律調節器等裝置，亦無已治療之證據。
